# Game Brain

> > Game Brain is a comprehensive video game discovery platform featuring games across all genres, platforms, and developers.

Game Brain catalogs video games from AAA titles to indie releases, including adult content, across platforms like Windows, Linux, Mac OS, and Android. The site provides detailed game pages, developer profiles, and discovery tools for gamers seeking their next experience.

## Key Topics

- Game discovery and cataloging
- Developer profiles
- Indie games
- Adult and erotic games
- Single-player experiences
- Multi-platform support (Windows, Linux, Mac OS, Android)
- Fighting games and arcade titles
- Survival horror
- MMORPGs and fantasy games
- Tabletop RPGs
- Hotpink games
- Krasue Games
- Tekken series
- Visual novels
- Multiplayer fighters

## Game Pages

- [Tekken Tag Tournament](https://gamebrain.co/game/200224): Namco's Tekken Tag Tournament game page, fourth in the series
- [Advance Wars: Dual Strike](https://gamebrain.co/game/105359): Intelligent Systems' turn-based strategy game for Nintendo DS
- [CTHULHU DEEP GREEN](https://gamebrain.co/game/227994): Tabletop RPG by Dissonance based on Graham Walmsley's Cthulhu Dark
- [Blade Fantasy-Immortal Epic](https://gamebrain.co/game/25412): Fantasy MMORPG mobile game by archei for Android platforms

## Developer Profiles

- [Hotpink Developer Profile](https://gamebrain.co/developer/hotpink): Developer profile for Hotpink showcasing games like Tentacle Locker 2
- [Krasue Games Developer Profile](https://gamebrain.co/developer/krasue-games): Krasue Games developer profile featuring survival horror indie titles
